title: Schedule VI ceiling on a collaborating pharmacist in a retail setting
rule_summary: Under 105 CMR 700.003(G)(4) the pharmacist, IF PRACTICING IN A RETAIL SETTING, may issue a prescription for a controlled substance IN SCHEDULE VI ONLY, in accordance with 105 CMR 700.003(G)(3).
exam_relevance: Tests the Department's own Schedule VI ceiling on a collaborating pharmacist practising in a retail setting, stated as one of the numbered conditions on the prescribing power.

authority.name: Massachusetts Department of Public Health regulations

exceptions: The subparagraph is addressed to a pharmacist practising in a retail setting; it states no ceiling for a pharmacist practising elsewhere.
common_confusions: The ceiling attaches to the retail setting, not to collaborative prescribing generally.
verification_notes: Read in the current official publication of 105 CMR 700.000 at the Department of Public Health download link on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule rather than by changing an existing record, so that no released adjudication is disturbed.
